newsitem.title: USA: A.H. Belo, Providence Journal okay merger.
newsitem.headline: A.H. Belo, Providence Journal okay merger.

text.p: A. H. Belo Corp and The Providence Journal Co said on Wednesday that shareholders of both companies overwhelmingly approved the merger of The Providence Journal Company into A. H. Belo.

Ninety-one percent of the votes of Belo shares outstanding were cast in favor of the issuance of up to 25.6 million shares of Series A Common Stock in connection with the merger, the companies said in a joint statement.
Over 71 percent of the votes of The Providence Journal shares outstanding were cast in favor of the terms of the merger, the companies said.
The transaction is expected to close as soon as possible, when all conditions to closing, including regulatory approval, are met, the companies said.
